notes.title: Patch 1.3.5 - Chapter 4 (Locked) Glitch Fixed & Removed Text Sound Effects
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, everyone![/b]

A new patch!? Yup! 

[u]Version 1.3.5[/u] is now live and you should be seeing release build 1.3.5 at the upper corner of the main menu. If you're not seeing the latest version number there, try updating the game manually or restarting your Steam client.

[b]Text SFX Removed[/b]
There was a problem with a previously added option to toggle the game's text sound effect off and on. While it's possible to fix this, I've decided to just remove it completely. Looking at it again now, the sound effect doesn't add anything to the game and rather than leaving it in the game and forcing players to disable it manually, it's probably better to just remove it altogether.

[b]Chapter 4 (Locked)[/b]
Fixed for a bug where clearing all NPC dialog before checking the lock caused an issue where players are unable to proceed with the puzzle. It's an old bug that I had already fixed, but apparently forgot to upload... 

[b]Text Updates[/b]
Removed a few lines of redundant and unimportant text lines. Found & fixed a few grammatical errors. 


As usual, please report any bugs, errors or even any suggestions and feedback by posting here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/652510/discussions/0/1368380934245938749/

notes.title: Patch 1.3.4 - Minor Glitches Fixed & Delayed Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, everyone![/b]

It's been a while but [b][u]version 1.3.4[/u][/b] has just been released for Windows. You should be seeing [u]release build 1.3.4[/u] at the upper right corner of the main menu. If not, please try restarting your Steam client to help kickstart the update process.

The MacOS version of the update is still in the works and should go live sometime in the coming week as I do not currently have a MacOS machine available to test the update. This announcement will be amended once the MacOS version is live so please do check back here if you're a MacOS user.

[b]Minor Fixes in Chapter 5 - The Final Stretch[/b]

Two minor glitches were fixed with this update:
[list]
[*] If you interact with the drawer with the phone without first triggering the locked box, you would turn to face upwards against the wall instead of towards the drawer.
[*] It's possible to trigger an outdated conversation with one NPC even after solving a particular puzzle ([spoiler]Vanessa's warning about the laser even though it has already been revealed[/spoiler]). Please let me know if anyone runs into this issue again even after the update. 
[/list]

[b]Text Updates[/b]

Updated conversation texts and fixed grammatical errors. 

[b]Delayed Announcement[/b]

Things happen, and unfortunately, that has caused delays after delays for my work-in-progress project, which was supposed to have been ready since late last year to early this year. [b]I am still working on it[/b], and although it's probably still months away from completion, I do plan to announce what it is next month.

[b]As usual, please report any bugs, errors or even any suggestions and feedback by posting here:[/b]

http://steamcommunity.com/app/652510/discussions/0/1368380934245938749/

Alternatively, you can also contact me directly from here:

notes.title: Patch 1.3.3 - Gamepad / Controller Config
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, everyone![/b]

[b][u]Version 1.3.3[/u][/b] is now up for both Windows and MacOS! If you see [u]release build 1.3.3[/u] at the upper right corner of the main menu, you're good to go. Otherwise, try restarting your Steam client. Unless you have disabled automatic updates, that should get the patch to download automatically.

[b]Gamepad / Controller Config Added[/b]

Added the ability to reconfigure your gamepad / controller. You can find this within the [u]options menu[/u]. While the game had always supported the use of gamepad / controllers, this provides the ability to remap your buttons to different functions.

[b]Minor Fix in Chapter 2 - Game Room[/b]

Fixed an issue with the statue puzzle in Chapter 2's Game Room. While you were able to delete your previous input by hitting the "Delete" or "Backspace" key on your keyboard, gamepad/controller players did not have any way to delete or clear the code that was entered before.

This is due to how the input was received, and fortunately this was the only puzzle that had used this method. Other similar puzzles in the game used a different method to receive input, so they are unaffected by this.

The statue puzzle is now using this other input method, so you can now use the cancel/delete when trying to solve this puzzle. If you had entered a wrong code, it will also be automatically cleared for when you try again.

[b]Grammatical Errors in Chapter 1[/b]

A few grammatical errors were found and fixed in Chapter 1 - Classroom.

[b]As usual, please report any bugs, errors or even any suggestions and feedback by posting here:[/b]

http://steamcommunity.com/app/652510/discussions/0/1368380934245938749/

Alternatively, you can also contact me directly from here:
http://neetbytes.com/contact/

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2 - Text Sound Effect Toggle
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, everyone![/b]

We're now running [b][u]version 1.3.2[/u][/b] on Steam for both Windows and MacOS!

As usual, if it reads [u]release build 1.3.2[/u] on the upper right corner of the main menu, that means you're up to date. Otherwise, just restart your Steam client to kick in the update process.

[b]Text Sound Effect Toggle[/b]

I realize that the "typing" sound effect when text are being shown may not be for everyone. In hindsight, this is something that should have been added from the beginning - giving the option to enable or disable the text sound effect.

With this update, you'll be able to enable or disable this sound effect by going to the in-game menu (press ESC while you're in the game) and select the option for [b]Text SFX[/b].

This will only disable the sound effect that plays while "conversational" text are showing. There will still be sound effect for button presses, choice selections, etc.

[b]Minor Fix in Classroom (Chapter 1)[/b]

- Fixed a minor issue where Roland and Alastor talks about the box in the drawer even if you've already opened it, if the conversation was not triggered previously.


[b]And once more, Happy 2018![/b]


[b]As usual, please report any bugs, errors or give suggestions and feedback by posting here:[/b]

http://steamcommunity.com/app/652510/discussions/0/1368380934245938749/

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1 - Minor Achievement Fix!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, everyone![/b]

[b][u]Version 1.3.1[/u][/b] is now live on Steam!

You should be seeing release build 1.3.1 on the top right corner of the main menu. If not, restarting your Steam client should run the update automatically.

[b]Achievement Fix[/b]

This is just a minor fix for the [b]Hidden Puzzle: Her Photo[/b] achievement. Before this, it would only trigger if you've previously unlocked [b]Hidden Puzzle: Silver Ring[/b] in the same save file. It will now trigger regardless of whether you've solved the Silver Ring puzzle or not.

[b]Minor Undocumented Updates[/b]

I've added small updates in the forms of very minor bug fixes, dialogue updates and movement tweaks over the last few months whenever I come across them. 

These are all very small issues that would probably go unnoticed anyway and to be honest, I can't really remember most of them. They were just added/fixed and were waiting for more important updates to get pushed out together.

[b]A late Merry Christmas, and an early Happy 2018![/b]

I'm a few days late, but I would still like to wish everyone a [u]Merry Christmas[/u] and a [b]Happy New Year[/b]! 

Curious about what's in store for 2018? There are a few things in the works but I won't reveal anything yet until I have something more solid to share, but please do look forward to it!


[b]As usual, please report any bugs, errors or give suggestions and feedback by posting here:[/b]

http://steamcommunity.com/app/652510/discussions/0/1368380934245938749/

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 - Now With Mac OS Support
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, everyone![/b]

[b][u]Version 1.3.0[/u][/b], which also [b][u]runs on Mac OS[/u][/b] is now available for download!

If your game is showing [b]release build 1.3.0[/b] at the upper right corner of the main menu, that means you're up to date. If you're still seeing an older build, restarting your Steam client would probably kick in the update process.

[b]Mac OS Support[/b]

I'm happy to announce that [b]ESCAPE Room: Reality[/b] now runs on Mac OS! This is something I've always planned on doing but had to wait until I've made sure the current version is stable, not to mention getting my hands on a Macbook long enough to test the game properly.

There may still be some bugs that I've missed, so please do report them if you run into any problems.

[b]A Couple of Bug Fixes:[/b]

1. Fixed an issue in Game Room where Roland would walk around during a scene instead of standing still under certain conditions.
2. Fixed an issue in Classroom where you can continue to activate the floor trigger whenever you touch it even after clearing the puzzle.

[b]On-going Dialogue Improvement[/b]

As an on-going effort to improve overall player experience, some dialogues have been edited / updated to flow better and to fix any grammatical errors.


[b]As usual, please report any bugs, errors or give suggestions and feedback by posting here:[/b]

http://steamcommunity.com/app/652510/discussions/0/1368380934245938749/

notes.title: Version 1.2.3 Ready for Download!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, everyone![/b]

[b][u]Version 1.2.3[/u][/b] has just gone live and if your game is now showing [b]release build 1.2.3[/b] at the upper right corner of the main menu, that means you're up to date!

If you're still seeing an older build, restarting your Steam client would probably kick in the update process.

[b]What's New?[/b]

This update provides a better way to check whether you should have already received any of the 8 new achievements that were added in version 1.2.1. 

Previously, the game will only check and award for the newly added achievements once you run through any of the endings. 

There are more points in the game now that checks for this and [b]in most cases[/b] you [i]should[/i] be awarded for the achievements the moment you load into your save game. If not, just play as usual, you will hit a checkpoint soon enough.

Please do report to me if you did not get your achievements so I can look into it. This is especially if you've already moved through another room or two.

[b]Updating Dialogues[/b]

Some dialogues have been tweaked and updated slightly to flow better. Also some not-so-important dialogues (for solving puzzles) will no longer repeat after you've already gone through it once. This will be an on-going effort to help improve overall player experience.


[b]As usual, please report any bugs, errors or provide suggestions and feedback by posting here:[/b]

http://steamcommunity.com/app/652510/discussions/0/1368380934245938749/

Alternatively, you can also contact me directly from here:
http://neetbytes.com/contact/

Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.2.1 Ready For Download!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, everyone![/b]

I'm happy to announce that a new update has been deployed and you [i]should[/i] automatically download the update when you're online or when you try to run the game.

[b]How do you know if your game is updated?[/b]
Just check the version number at the top right corner of the main menu. It should read as [b][u]release build 1.2.1[/u][/b]


Here's the list of changes and fixes for version 1.2.1:


Main Changes
===============
1. Additional hints for [b]Dark Maze[/b] and [b]Final Stretch[/b]
2. Autosave function at the start of most rooms, allocated to save slot 21 
3. Added 8 new achievements 
4. All known bugs that has been fixed as listed below


Bug Fixes
===============
1. BGM stop trigger in Chapter 2
2. Alastor's clone in Chapter 5: Twin Rooms (after triggering stone wall & during second conversation across the wall)
3. Incorrectly displaying only 6 Hidden Puzzles in the final screen after completing the game through route Chapter 4M -> Chapter 5M. This should actually be 7
4. Incorrectly displaying only 7 Hidden Puzzles in the final screen after completing the game through route Chapter 4M -> Chapter 5V. This should actually be 8
5. TypeError when selecting "Filters" from Option.
6. Alastor sometimes getting stuck in Chapter 4: 3 Doors
7. Flower pots trigger not resetting after returning to initial position in Chapter 4: 3 Doors
8. Achievement "Hidden Puzzle: Hearts" does not trigger under certain circumstances
9. In Chapter 3: Water Room, holding down the spacebar to speed through the dialogue may cause the game to get stuck


[b]Additional Information[/b]

1. Holding down the [b]spacebar[/b] will help move dialogues along at a much faster rate. This is useful for when you've already read the dialogue and wish to move along quickly.

2. The autosave will [u]always[/u] save in save slot 21. [b]DO NOT[/b] put your own save here as it [u]will[/u] be overwritten the next time autosave is triggered.

[b]About the New Achievements[/b]

If you've completed the game before, just re-play the ending scene and credits and all the achievements that you should have received [b]during that particular playthrough[/b] will be awarded around the post-credit scene.



[b]Please report any bugs/mistakes or suggestions and feedback by posting here[/b]:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/652510/discussions/0/1368380934245938749/

Special thanks to LastNonak and Sheepscuit for their help with reporting bugs and also their feedback and suggestions. 

If you need any help with solving a particular puzzle, progressing through the game or hunting for a specific achievement, check out LastNonak's guide in the guide section, he has a 100% complete guide up!

There are still more work to be done, but with this update I hope all of you will be able to enjoy the game better.

Thank you!
